name: Minimum Kakeya set in F_31^3
definition: Choose one affine line in every projective direction of F_31^3 and minimize the cardinality of the union of all chosen lines.
solution_format: An object with lines, a list of 993 objects. Each object has direction and origin, three integer coordinates in [0,30]. Directions use the canonical representative whose last nonzero coordinate is 1.
constraints: The field is F_31, with arithmetic modulo 31, and the ambient dimension is 3.
There are 993 projective directions. Each direction must occur exactly once.
A direction is represented by its unique nonzero vector whose last nonzero coordinate is 1.
Each line is {origin + t*direction : t in F_31} for one origin in F_31^3.
All 31 points on every represented line belong to the candidate union. The objective is the exact number of distinct points in that union.

parameters.construction: one affine line in each projective direction
parameters.objective: cardinality of the union of the represented lines

verification: The checker requires exactly one canonical line for each of the 993 projective directions. It generates all 31 points per line using integer arithmetic modulo 31, forms the exact union, and returns its cardinality.
